mentions.name: Damon
mentions.description: A Nomad events stream operator that automates cluster operations as a lightweight Go binary. It monitors the Nomad events stream and triggers actions via configurable providers: spawning auxiliary jobs to back up data from services like PostgreSQL or Redis based on job meta tags, running a lightweight DNS server for cross-namespace service discovery that works as a drop-in resolver for HAProxy and Nginx, and executing user-defined shell scripts as Nomad jobs on event triggers. Its provider-based architecture is extensible with custom tags, job and ACL templates, event triggers, and go-plugin support for runtime extension.
mentions.problem: Eliminates repetitive, mundane DevOps and operational tasks that teams keep putting off, reducing gruntwork in Nomad clusters.
mentions.audience: Teams running Nomad clusters who want to automate repetitive operational tasks
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on Damon[1], a Nomad Events stream operator that automates cluster operations and eliminates repetitive DevOps tasks. It's a lightweight Go binary that monitors the Nomad events stream and triggers actions based on configurable providers.
